name: giskard-risk-evals-console
description: The red-team console's frontend; the built files in riskdemo/static/ are committed, so running the app needs only Python

scripts.build: npm run check && esbuild client/app.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=riskdemo/static/app.js && tailwindcss -i client/styles.css -o riskdemo/static/app.css --minify && node --import=tsx scripts/article.ts
